meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: 它把任务拆成一条条绑定可观察证据的超细步骤,用 ulw-loop CLI 在 .omo/ulw-loop 下登记目标并同步进度,把代码修改、测试和 QA 派给子代理执行,中断后能按检查点接着跑。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop、可长期续跑的目标执行或带检查点的长任务时接管;任务涉及代码改动、测试或提交时按完整流程走。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 做这件事,先按 define-goal 注册目标
say.note: 先建目标再动手,这一步不跳过

say.text: 把这个任务拆成原子步骤,每步都要可观察的证据
say.note: 步骤会同步进 update_plan,只有一条在进行

say.text: 带上原来的 session-id,恢复上次的 ulw-loop 运行继续
say.note: 先读目标与账本,不重新规划

howto.what_en: It splits work into ultra-granular, evidence-bound steps, keeps goal and progress state in the ulw-loop CLI under .omo/ulw-loop, delegates code edits, tests and QA to subagents, and resumes from checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, durable goal execution, or a checkpointed long-running task; code edits, tests or commits follow the full workflow.

say_en.text: Do this with ulw-loop, registering the goal per define-goal first
Break this into atomic steps, each with observable evidence
say_en.note: Steps mirror the live update_plan checklist

say_en.text: Resume the previous ulw-loop run with its original session-id
say_en.note: Re-reads brief, goals and ledger first
